results.name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Brace your core and raise both knees up and across toward one shoulder.
Pause at the top, feeling the side of your waist contract.
Lower your legs with control without swinging, then repeat toward the other side.
tips: Pull your shoulders down away from your ears to protect them.
Move slowly; momentum takes the work away from your obliques.
results.description: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Forearms.

results.name: Heel Touches
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Position your arms along your sides with your palms facing down.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor, engaging your core and keeping your neck relaxed.
Reach your right hand towards your right heel, bending your torso to the side. Return to the center and then reach your left hand towards your left heel.
Alternate sides in a controlled manner, maintaining the contraction in your core throughout the exercise. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move slowly and with control to maximize the effectiveness of the exercise and prevent injury.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you reach towards your heel and inhaling as you return to the center.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor to prevent strain.
results.description: Heel Touches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: High Cable Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a high pulley on a cable machine. Kneel down facing the machine, holding the rope handles with both hands, and position them close to your head.
Keep your back straight and engage your core muscles to pull the rope down by crunching your torso towards your knees, bringing your elbows towards your thighs.
Just before your elbows touch your thighs, return to the starting position with control, keeping the tension on the cable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees are firmly planted on the floor for stability.
Keep your hips stable and avoid using momentum.
Exhale as you crunch down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: High Cable Kneeling Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: High Knee Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms raised to shoulder height in front of you, palms facing down.
Lift your right knee towards your left elbow while simultaneously twisting your torso to the right, engaging your core.
Return to the starting position, then lift your left knee towards your right elbow while twisting your torso to the left.
Alternate sides in a controlled manner, maintaining a steady rhythm. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Twist your torso and lift your knee simultaneously to engage both your abs and obliques.
Move smoothly and with control to avoid straining your back or hips.
Ensure your movements are balanced and controlled to prevent injury.
results.description: High Knee Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: High Resistance Band Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a high anchor point. Kneel down facing the anchor point, holding the handles of the resistance band with both hands, bend your arms at 90 degrees to bring your hands close to your face, palms facing each other.
Pull the resistance band down by crunching your torso towards your knees, bringing your elbows towards your thighs.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, keeping the tension on the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees are firmly planted on the floor for stability.
Keep your hips stable and avoid using momentum.
Exhale as you crunch down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: High Resistance Band Kneeling Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Medicine Ball Hold the World
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Hold a medicine ball above the center of your chest with both hands and your elbows bent.
Press the medicine ball straight upward until your arms are extended above your chest.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping the ball steady.
Bend your elbows and lower the ball toward your chest with control, then repeat.
tips: Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
Press the ball straight upward without moving it toward your head.
Avoid bouncing the ball against your chest.
Inhale as you lower the ball and exhale as you press it upward.
results.description: Medicine Ball Hold the World is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms stretched overhead.
Engage your core and lift your shoulders and legs off the floor, keeping your lower back pressed into the floor. Your body should form a slight curve with your arms and legs elevated.
Hold this position, maintaining tension in your core and keeping your lower back flat against the floor.
Continue to hold the position for the desired duration, then slowly lower your shoulders and legs back to the starting position.
tips: Ensure your shoulders and legs are lifted at the same height to create a balanced position.
Focus on steady breathing, inhaling through your nose and exhaling through your mouth to help maintain focus and endurance.
If the full hollow hold is too challenging, you can modify the position by bending your knees or keeping your arms by your sides.
Avoid straining your neck; keep it relaxed and in line with your spine.
results.description: Hollow Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Jack Knives
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms stretched on your sides.
Simultaneously lift your upper body and legs towards each other, reaching your hands towards your feet. Engage your core to lift both your torso and legs.
Try to touch your hands to your feet at the top of the movement, forming a "V" shape with your body.
Slowly lower your upper body and legs back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: If the full movement is too challenging, modify by bending your knees slightly.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you lift your body and inhaling as you lower it.
Ensure your lower back remains pressed into the floor during the movement to prevent strain.
results.description: Jack Knives is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: L Sit Hold
instructions: Place your hands on parallel bars, dip handles or the floor next to your hips.
Press down to lift your body, locking your elbows and pushing your shoulders down.
Raise your straight legs in front of you until they are parallel to the floor, forming an L shape.
Hold the position for the set time while breathing steadily, then lower with control.
tips: Point your toes and squeeze your thighs together to keep your legs straight.
Bend your knees (tuck sit) if you can't yet hold straight legs.
results.description: L Sit Hold is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Quadriceps.

results.name: Landmine Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with the landmine bar beside you and hold the end of the bar above your chest with both hands.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and straight legs off the ground.
Keep your arms extended, holding the bar steady over your chest in the hollow position.
Hold for the set time while breathing steadily, then lower your legs and shoulders with control.
tips: Your lower back must stay flat on the floor; raise your legs higher if it arches.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
results.description: Landmine Hollow Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.
